comment: Action-name taxonomies used for accounting, health, and the /api/log filter (CEREMONY_ACTIONS, PROGRESS_ACTIONS, REWORK_ACTIONS, API_LOG_ALLOWED_ACTIONS). Operator/village-edited: a new action name added in code must be listed here or the accounting silently ignores it. The passport hash chain list (_HASHED_ACTIONS) is deliberately NOT here: it is tamper-evidence enforcement and stays in serve.py.
